name: std::coroutine_handle<Promise>::promise
intro:
Obtains a reference to the promise object.

The behavior is undefined if *this does not refer to a coroutine whose promise object has not been destroyed.

This function is not provided for the specialization std::coroutine_handle<>.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A reference to the promise object.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: The promise object of a no-op coroutine is not destroyed as long as there is some std::noop_coroutine_handle referring to the coroutine.

summary: Obtains a reference to the promise object.
